## Source and safety

- What changed (and why):
- Shared runtime/packwiz/quest owners and potential collisions:
- Frozen donor source SHA, touched paths, merge/retirement provenance (if any):
- Version, dependency, source licensing, fallback/rollback notes:

- Explicit out-of-scope assumptions:

## Checks and QA handoff

- [ ] Repository CI / static validators (link; or blockers)
- [ ] Module CI if applicable (link; or NOT RUN)
- [ ] Read-only Integration Preflight (link; or NOT RUN)
- [ ] No automatic full assembly, Minecraft boot, Prism ZIP or release triggered
- [ ] Exact packwiz locks/hashes and register match (if changing mods)
- [ ] No higher-level PASS implied from source-only evidence
- **A — offline**: commands, evidence and status:
- **B — in-game commands**: exact verified commands, permissions, expected output, cleanup:
- **C — manual**: setup and gameplay acceptance:
- Blockers, next action, retained/deleted branch plan:
